newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia April trade data due on Friday -Bernama.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia April trade data due on Friday -Bernama.

text.p: Malaysia's monthly trade data for April will be released on Friday, the national news agency Bernama said on Thursday.
Bernama, which disseminates the figures, said the Statistics Department data will be released at 1200 local time (0400 GMT).
A Reuters poll of nine economists had put an average trade deficit of 273.6 million ringgit for April.
Malaysia posted a trade surplus of 1.75 billion ringgit in March.
